arguments.public_rationale: The fort is still entirely on the surface and has no workshops at all. The largest open clearing near the heart of the fort is 5 tiles south of the Embark Site, in the same walkable group as the Wagon and Stockpile #1. Siting the first workshop there puts production right next to the embark's starting materials and both stockpiles, with no hauling detour, and commits nothing about the later underground layout.
arguments.rationale: Uniboslan is still an all-surface fort. All four landmarks — Embark Site, Wagon, Stockpile #1 and Stockpile #2 — are walkable and every exit between them is walkable, and the connectivity check confirms Wagon and Stockpile #2 sit in the same walkable group (group 11, the main group), so the whole surface core is one connected hauling network of population 15 with no alerts and no stuck jobs. What is missing is production: the landmark list shows no workshops, rooms or burrows, and diggable.find at the Embark Site's level returns nothing within 60 tiles of the Embark Site, Stockpile #1, Stockpile #2 or the Wagon, so there is no diggable wall bordering the walkable network and therefore no interior to site anything in yet. The best surface candidate is the large clearing found 5 tiles south of the Embark Site (7x7, in the same walkable group as the Wagon, which sits 1 tile east of the Embark Site, and Stockpile #1, which sits 3 tiles southwest of it). A workshop there is reachable from the Wagon and from both stockpiles without crossing unwalkable ground and without any hauling detour, which matters because the Wagon is the only material cache a fresh embark has. Siting the first workshop on that clearing is the cheapest productive move available, it commits no later interior layout, and it can be re-sited once a dug fort exists. Only a larger clearing 12 tiles west of the Wagon competes, and it is farther from the Wagon and from both stockpiles, so it is a strictly worse first choice.
arguments.summary: Site the fort's first workshop in the large surface clearing south of the Embark Site, on the side facing the Wagon.
